# Build documents

`REPLICA_PROMPT.md` is the product specification in force: the design prototype
(`../design/claude-design/`) as a working product, screen by screen, with the owner's later
decisions (sign-in pages, Ask without sample text, no credits on user screens, model choice,
files of any size, limits, private workspaces). Code comments and module docstrings cite it by
name. `PHASE_4B_PLAN.md` records the owner's later reversals and wins where it disagrees
with the prompt.

The earlier prompts, plans and logs (BUILD_PROMPT, FIX_PROMPT, FIX_LOG, PLAN, REPLICA_PLAN,
UNDERSTANDING, the visual pass the owner rejected) are history and live in
`/home/sakib/unused code ABM generator/docs-history/build/`. The running record of what was built is
`../../BUILD_LOG.md`.
